mike (Mike H.): deploy-bot just kicked off rollout 1.72.0 -> prod (region: us-west). Watch SLOs, please.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: deployment_id=dep-78f3, targets=100 hosts, step=canary 10% -> 30m
elaine (Elaine G.): got dashboard open https://dash.redwood.ai/d/xyz/slo-overview?org=infra - p95 embeddings latency creeping
sam (Sam P.): seeing embed-route p95 from 160ms -> 420ms over last 4 mins, error rate +0.6% (5xxs spike)
mike (Mike H.): is this in traffic for the new model or sidecar change?
elaine (Elaine G.): appears correlated with node pool draining in us-west-2c, new runtime image rolled to canaries
mike (Mike H.): @deploy-bot current canary hosts healthy? any restarts?
deploy-bot: Canary health: 9/10 ok, 1 crashloop on host i-0b12. Recent 5xx count=48 in 5m (baseline 2-5).
sam (Sam P.): I can pin traffic back to v1.71.9 on the router if we want to stop ramp. quick command: `robin rollback --service embed --to v1.71.9`
mike (Mike H.): hold on, let's triage logs first. Elaine can you paste the failing stacktrace?
elaine (Elaine G.): tailing logs: `2026-03-22T18:02:31Z ERROR kvcache: failed to restore token-kv: EOF` then a flurry of 502s. Looks like kvcache open error.
sam (Sam P.): kvcache GC config changed in the new image; might be memory pressure. We saw a small GC bump in staging last week.
mike (Mike H.): given 5xx spike and p95 jump, recommend PAUSE ramp and pin to previous version for safety. Sam, run the pin. I'll create an incident note.
sam (Sam P.): running: `router pin --service embed --version v1.71.9 --reason 'canary kvcache 5xx spike'` ... pinned. Routing shifted back to stable. Notifying SRE oncall.
oncall-bot: Alert: embed-route 5xx rate back to baseline after pin (~6 minutes). SLO p95 trending down. Incident created: INC-2026-113
elaine (Elaine G.): confirm no residual OOMs on pinned hosts. I'll open a deeper debug runbook for kvcache GC tweak.
mike (Mike H.): Thanks. Let's keep slow rollout blocked until kvcache fix validated. Add a canary gate: require kvcache restored and <0.2% 5xx for 15m.
sam (Sam P.): noted. I'll also throttle future ramp to 5% increments with 10m wait. Updated rollout config.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by policy. Reason=canary-5xx-threshold-exceeded. To resume, create /rollout resume with owner tag.
elaine (Elaine G.): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with runtime team for GC patch and a follow-up canary tomorrow morning.
mike (Mike H.): closing loop: release notes updated with rollback reason + SLO link. Good job everyone.
